title: Some prayers don’t get answered.
paragraphs:
Some prayers don’t get answered.
Not because God is deaf.
But because something deeper is happening.

You whispered it.
You cried it.
You begged heaven like your life depended on it.

And still—
silence.
So the question burns: Is God ignoring me?
But here’s what we miss…

God never ignores a heart that truly seeks Him.
But He does resist what is not aligned with Him.
Scripture doesn’t hide this.

“If I had cherished sin in my heart, the Lord would not have listened.” — Psalm 66:18
“You ask and do not receive, because you ask wrongly…” — James 4:3
That’s heavy.

Not every prayer is pure.
Not every request is surrendered.
Sometimes we’re asking God to bless what He’s trying to break.
Let that sink in.

We pray for open doors—
but refuse to walk away from sin.

We pray for peace—
but cling to pride.

We pray for blessing—
but won’t release control.
And heaven stays quiet.

Not out of cruelty.
But out of mercy.

Because if God answered every prayer as-is,
some of us would be destroyed by what we thought we needed.
But here’s where grace walks in.
Jesus.
Because of Christ, rejected sinners become heard children.
“If we confess our sins, He is faithful and just to forgive…” — 1 John 1:9

Through Jesus, your broken, messy, misaligned prayers—
they don’t get discarded.
They get redeemed.

God doesn’t just answer prayers.
He transforms the one praying.
So if heaven feels silent, don’t run away.
Lean in.

Ask:
“Lord, is there something in me You want to change?”

Because sometimes the greatest answer to prayer
is not “yes” or “no”—
It’s “come closer.”
And in Christ, you always can.
Sit with it. Pray again—but this time, surrender everything.
From silence to surrender—because Jesus still listens.
